slice: PR 3 of 3: the visibility rules per dive state and mode. Every control of the dive screen walked through the setup, the surface, under water, back at 0 m, a stop, fast-forward running, the gas page, the help, a drill's decision and debriefing, bailed out, the game over and the debriefing, in rec, tec and ccr, on a phone and a desktop, against legacy's src/touch.js; the Info button is offered at every depth of a dive under way, as legacy's 'diving' state
workingTree: the runs in `results` ran on ed5e509's tree, unchanged; the commit after it adds only this file, which neither the build nor the tests read

e2e.command: npx playwright test tests/control-visibility.spec.js tests/touch-dpad.spec.js tests/touch-context.spec.js tests/in-dive-controls.spec.js tests/help-overlay.spec.js tests/drills.spec.js tests/instructor-panel.spec.js --workers=1
